marks.gloss_en: הא כיצד -- 'from one': a part of the larger name suffices
הא כיצד -- 'one': the part must itself be a name, not a single letter
the verse says 'one' (Lev 4:22) -- [a single letter is not a labour]
הא כיצד -- 'from one': not the whole labour
הא כיצד -- 'one': a labour of which the like endures
R' Shimon: how so? he is not liable until he does a labour of which the like endures
שכן רושמין על קרשי המשכן -- the Tabernacle practice grounds the marking-liability
לפיכך -- therefore, since the liability is marking, a scratch across two boards is liable
R' Yosei: is he liable on account of writing? he is liable only on account of marking
דתניא, רבי יהודה אומר משום רבן גמליאל: אפילו לא כתב אלא שתי אותיות והן שם אחד -- חייב (kind tanya_kevatei: no kind names a bare דתניא)
לא קשיא: הא דידיה, הא דרביה -- the mishna's is his own view, the baraita's is his teacher's (= p_ha_derabeih)
the stam: no difficulty -- this [the mishna's] is his own, that [the baraita's] is his teacher's
מאי טעמא דרבי יוסי? אחת מאחת, הנה מהנה -- the doubled forms are R' Yosei's reason
R' Yosei b. R' Chanina: R' Yosei's reason -- 'one'/'from one', 'these'/'from these': one that is these, and these that are one
ומי מצית אמרת הכי? והתניא, רבי שמעון אומר: ועשה אחת, יכול עד שיכתוב את השם כולו -- תלמוד לומר מאחת! -- R' Shimon's own baraita rejects requiring the whole name
תריץ ואימא הכי: יכול עד שיכתוב את הפסוק כולו -- emend: R' Shimon rejected requiring the whole VERSE (= p_tarretz_hapasuk)
the stam: rather, R' Shimon comes to teach us this: [not liable] until he writes the whole name
R' Yosei: 'and does one', 'and does these' -- sometimes one is liable once for all of them, and sometimes for each one
(entertained) R' Shimon's position is the same as the first tanna's
the baraita: one who drills any amount is liable
'one' is [writing the whole name] Shimon
זאת אומרת -- Rav Chisda infers it from R' Yehuda's counting Shem-from-Shimon
מי דמי? מ״ם דשם סתום, מ״ם דשמעון פתוח -- is it alike? the mem of Shem is closed, the mem of Shimon is open!
אמר רב חסדא: זאת אומרת סתום ועשאו פתוח כשר -- a closed letter made open is valid (= p_rav_chisda_stum_patuach)
the stam: the mem of Shem is closed, the mem of Shimon is open
ומדפתוח ועשאו סתום כשר -- the derasha counts an open letter written closed
סתום נמי סתום ועשאו פתוח כשר -- closed made open is likewise valid
an open letter that one made closed is valid
מי דמי? פתוח ועשאו סתום -- עלויי קא מעלי ליה; סתום ועשאו פתוח -- גרועי קא מגרע ליה (104a.1)
מיתיבי: וכתבתם -- כתיבה תמה ... סתומין פתוחין -- one may not write closed letters as open
'and you shall write them' -- the writing must be perfect: not alef for ayin, ayin for alef, bet for kaf ... (letter for letter)
הוא דאמר כי האי תנא -- Rav Chisda spoke according to R' Yehuda ben Beteira's derasha of מים
he [Rav Chisda] spoke in accordance with this tanna
the baraita: [one may not write] closed letters as open, nor open as closed
